name: Slice-Based Data-Space Parallel Distribution
definition: Distributes a 3D voxel dataset across parallel processors by assigning contiguous 2D slices to each node, enabling local processing and reducing communication overhead.
summary: Slice-Based Data-Space Parallel Distribution partitions 3D volumes into 2D slices for local processing, reducing per-node memory and leveraging high X-Y resolution, unlike display-space methods that distribute rendering tasks.
